children.text: UCTP
TRN-01 · Register a taxpayer
AC-1 Section "1 — Create a taxpayer" shows "[full name] created — mobile [mobile]."
Upon page load: ASK: Exact initial state of the result box?
Functional validations: POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers returns 201 with taxpayer_id.
Steps: 1. Enter "Ana <random> Dela Cruz" and a unique PH mobile. 2. Click "Create taxpayer".
A1 · Function + : POST with a unique full name and mobile -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id
W1 · Function + : Create taxpayer with the entered name and mobile -> result box shows "[trimmed full name] created — mobile [mobile]."
A2 · General - : ASK: Required-field behavior and exact response for an empty full name?
A3 · General - : ASK: Required-field behavior and exact response for an empty mobile?
A4 · Function - : Submit a duplicate mobile -> HTTP 409, detail.mobile "already registered for this tenant"
AC-2 The same taxpayer details show under My data › My taxpayers.
Functional validations: GET /api/v1/training/taxpayers lists my taxpayers.
Steps: 1. Create a taxpayer. 2. Open My data › My taxpayers.
A5 · Store + : GET taxpayers after creation -> ASK: Exact response body structure and status code?
W2 · Store + : Open My data › My taxpayers after creation -> the created taxpayer's name and mobile appear
A6 · Store - : ASK: Exact API response when the taxpayer list is empty?
W3 · Navigation - : Open My taxpayers before creating a taxpayer -> ASK: Exact empty-list screen state?
I1 · Store - : Compare the created taxpayer with the list entry -> ASK: Exact API fields and screen values to compare?
AC-3 Spaces around the name are removed, both in the "created" message and in My data.
Functional validations: Leading and trailing spaces are removed from full_name.
Steps: 1. Enter a name with leading and trailing spaces. 2. Create taxpayer. 3. Open My taxpayers.
W4 · General + : Enter "  Ana <random> Dela Cruz  " -> created message and My taxpayers show "Ana <random> Dela Cruz" without surrounding spaces
A7 · General + : POST a full_name with surrounding spaces -> ASK: Exact stored full_name in GET response?
W5 · Inputs - : Paste a name with internal repeated spaces -> ASK: Whether internal spaces are collapsed or preserved?
W6 · Store - : Reload My taxpayers after creation -> ASK: Exact persistence behavior and displayed name?
I2 · Store - : Compare POST input, creation message and GET result -> ASK: Exact API field containing the trimmed name?
AC-4 A mobile that's already registered is not accepted.
Functional validations: A mobile already registered for the TAGAYTAY tenant is refused.
Steps: 1. Create a taxpayer. 2. Submit another taxpayer using the same mobile.
A8 · Domain/Data + : POST a second taxpayer with the previously registered mobile -> HTTP 409, detail.mobile "already registered for this tenant"
A9 · Domain/Data - : POST a mobile registered to another taxpayer in TAGAYTAY -> HTTP 409, detail.mobile "already registered for this tenant"
A10 · Domain/Data - : ASK: Does duplicate detection normalize 09 and +639 representations of the same mobile?
A11 · Store - : Retry the duplicate request -> ASK: Whether the original taxpayer remains unchanged and the second taxpayer remains absent?
W7 · Function - : Submit a previously registered mobile -> ASK: Exact screen presentation of "already registered for this tenant"?
AC-5 Name accepts only 2–100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ. Message: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
Element validations: Full name - 2–100 characters; permitted characters are letters, spaces, period, hyphen, apostrophe and Ñ.
Steps: 1. Enter a name. 2. Submit the form.
A12 · Domain/Data + : POST a 2-character permitted name -> HTTP 201 with taxpayer_id
A13 · Numbers - : POST a 1-character name -> HTTP 422, detail.full_name "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
A14 · Numbers - : POST a 101-character name -> HTTP 422, detail.full_name "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
A15 · Syntax - : POST a name containing an unlisted character such as @ -> HTTP 422, detail.full_name "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
W8 · Syntax - : Type a name containing @ -> ASK: Exact form behavior before submission and result-box behavior after submission?
AC-6 Email is optional. If typed, it needs one @ with a dot after it, 254 characters max. Message: "invalid email format"
Element validations: Email - optional; one @, a dot after @, maximum 254 characters.
Steps: 1. Leave email empty or enter an email. 2. Submit the form.
A16 · Syntax + : POST with email omitted -> ASK: Exact API response and whether email is stored as null or omitted?
A17 · Numbers + : POST an email of exactly 254 characters with the required format -> ASK: Whether HTTP 201 is returned?
A18 · Syntax - : POST an email with no @ -> HTTP 422, detail.email "invalid email format"
A19 · Syntax - : POST an email with two @ characters -> HTTP 422, detail.email "invalid email format"
A20 · Numbers - : POST an email of 255 characters -> HTTP 422, detail.email "invalid email format"
W9 · Syntax - : Enter an email with no dot after @ -> ASK: Exact screen behavior and timing of the message?
AC-7 A taxpayer created under my name-tag shows only for that name-tag. Under another name-tag, My data shows "None yet — create one in Training setup." and the Taxpayer lists are empty.
Element validations: Your name - initial name-tag Mitch-6973; alternate name-tag Mitch-6973-other.
Steps: 1. Save Mitch-6973 in the Your name box. 2. Create a taxpayer. 3. Use top bar › Change. 4. Switch to Mitch-6973-other. 5. Open My data and taxpayer lists.
A21 · User + : GET taxpayers with X-User-ID: Mitch-6973 -> ASK: Exact response structure containing the created taxpayer?
A22 · User - : GET taxpayers with X-User-ID: Mitch-6973-other -> ASK: Exact empty-list API response and status code?
W10 · User + : Open My taxpayers as Mitch-6973 -> the created taxpayer appears
W11 · User - : Switch to Mitch-6973-other and open My data -> "None yet — create one in Training setup."
W12 · User - : Switch to Mitch-6973-other and open Taxpayer lists -> all taxpayer lists are empty
I3 · User - : Compare the other name-tag's GET response and screen -> ASK: Exact API response schema for confirming tenant/user isolation?
AC-8 Mobile accepts only 09 + 9 digits, or +639 + 9 digits. No spaces, no dashes. Message: "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"
Element validations: Mobile - exactly 11 digits beginning 09, or +639 followed by 9 digits; no spaces or dashes.
Steps: 1. Enter a mobile. 2. Submit the form.
A23 · Syntax + : POST mobile 09123456789 -> ASK: Exact HTTP response code and response body for an accepted mobile?
A24 · Syntax + : POST mobile +639123456789 -> ASK: Exact HTTP response code and response body for an accepted mobile?
A25 · Syntax - : POST mobile 08123456789 -> HTTP 422, detail.mobile "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"
A26 · Syntax - : POST mobile 0912345678 (10 digits) -> HTTP 422, detail.mobile "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"
A27 · Syntax - : POST mobile 091234567890 (12 digits) -> HTTP 422, detail.mobile "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"
A28 · General - : POST mobile 09123 456789 -> HTTP 422, detail.mobile "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"
A29 · General - : POST mobile 09123-456789 -> HTTP 422, detail.mobile "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"
W13 · Syntax - : Enter a mobile containing letters -> ASK: Exact form behavior and message timing?
